displayIdentity.body: Paul grounds apostolic rights in work, law, and the Lord’s command. Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Haven’t I seen Jesus Christ, our Lord? Aren’t you my work in the Lord? Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.
